text:
### Reporting Frequency  
- **Daily:** Capital ratio, system availability, fraud incidents
- **Weekly:** Operational incidents, compliance alerts
- **Monthly:** KRI summary to management, operational losses
- **Quarterly:** Full risk dashboard to Board Risk Committee
- **Annually:** Comprehensive risk assessment to Board  
---
name: Chunk 15/18

raw_entities.name: Capital Ratio
raw_entities.description: A key risk indicator monitored and reported daily to track the bank's capital adequacy position. This metric is escalated to the Board Risk Committee quarterly as part of the full risk dashboard.
context: Daily: Capital ratio, system availability, fraud incidents
Quarterly: Full risk dashboard to Board Risk Committee

raw_entities.name: System Availability
raw_entities.description: An operational risk metric tracked on a daily basis to monitor the bank's technology infrastructure and service continuity. System availability is reported alongside capital ratio and fraud incidents in daily reporting.
context: Daily: Capital ratio, system availability, fraud incidents

raw_entities.name: Fraud Incident Rate
raw_entities.description: A daily-reported key risk indicator tracking the frequency and volume of fraud incidents detected across the bank's operations. This metric is part of the daily reporting cadence to senior management.
context: Daily: Capital ratio, system availability, fraud incidents

raw_entities.name: Operational Incident Rate
raw_entities.description: A weekly-reported metric tracking operational incidents across the bank. This indicator is escalated to management on a weekly basis alongside compliance alerts.
context: Weekly: Operational incidents, compliance alerts

raw_entities.name: Compliance Alert Volume
raw_entities.description: A weekly-reported metric tracking compliance-related alerts and exceptions. This indicator is monitored and reported to management on a weekly basis.
context: Weekly: Operational incidents, compliance alerts

raw_entities.name: Key Risk Indicator Summary
raw_entities.description: A monthly aggregated summary of key risk indicators reported to management. This consolidated view provides management with a comprehensive overview of the bank's risk profile on a monthly basis.
context: Monthly: KRI summary to management, operational losses

raw_entities.name: Operational Loss
raw_entities.description: A monthly-reported metric tracking operational losses incurred by the bank. This indicator is part of the monthly reporting package to management.
context: Monthly: KRI summary to management, operational losses

raw_entities.name: Board Risk Committee Quarterly Risk Dashboard Review
raw_entities.description: A quarterly governance reporting obligation where a full risk dashboard is presented to the Board Risk Committee. This comprehensive review covers all material risk metrics and indicators.
context: Quarterly: Full risk dashboard to Board Risk Committee

raw_entities.name: Board Annual Comprehensive Risk Assessment Review
raw_entities.description: An annual governance reporting obligation where a comprehensive risk assessment is presented to the Board. This annual review provides the Board with a full evaluation of the bank's risk landscape.
context: Annually: Comprehensive risk assessment to Board
